points.name: Airoli-Katai Naka elevated road (nearest point)
points.status: under construction in OSM; opening not confirmed
points.note: MMRDA project. Free Press Journal, 7 May 2026: Phase II (Airoli to Thane-Belapur Road, about 2.57 km) 100% complete, Phase I (to NH-4, with a 1.69 km twin tunnel) 92% of civil works done. Free Press Journal, 26 Jun 2026: both phases 'set to be commissioned in July' 2026. No report that it actually opened was found (searched 20 Nov 2026), and OSM still tags it highway=construction, so it is not routed and must not be called open.

metro_status.airoli_metro_station: does not exist and is not under construction
metro_status.summary: There is no metro station at Airoli today, and none is being built. The only metro plan that names Airoli is Mumbai Metro Line 14 (Kanjurmarg-Badlapur, about 44 km, 24 stations), which is at the feasibility-study stage: MMRDA invited bids for a feasibility consultant in June 2026. Construction World (21 Aug 2025) lists Airoli among the stations 'under consideration' (with Turbhe, Digha, Ambernath and Badlapur) on an alignment that runs underground from Kanjurmarg to Ghansoli and elevated beyond; no station site, construction start or opening date has been published. The airport-to-airport Metro Line 8 does not list Airoli among its Navi Mumbai stations (Free Press Journal, 9 Dec 2025). The nearest metro under construction is Line 4 in Thane/Mulund (Teen Hath Naka, Mulund Check Naka); its first phase is targeted for end of December 2026.
metro_status.say_this: Airoli is among the stations under consideration on the planned Metro Line 14 (feasibility study tendered June 2026). Today the site is served by two suburban stations, Airoli and Digha Gaon.
metro_status.do_not_say: Airoli metro station (as if it exists or is being built). Also do not say Metro Line 8 (the airport line) serves Airoli.
sources: https://swarajyamag.com/news-brief/mmrda-revives-437-km-metro-line-14-project-floats-fresh-tender-for-feasibility-study-on-kanjurmargbadlapur-corridor (24 Jun 2026; feasibility tender, 43.7 km, 24 stations; does not name Airoli)

https://www.constructionworld.in/transport-infrastructure/metro-rail-and-railways-infrastructure/metro-14-to-link-kanjurmarg-with-badlapur-in-thane/77869 (21 Aug 2025; Airoli among stations under consideration)
https://www.freepressjournal.in/mumbai/metro-line-8-to-link-mumbai-navi-mumbai-airports-with-11-stations-across-key-suburbs (9 Dec 2025; Line 8 Navi Mumbai stations, Airoli not among them)

OpenStreetMap, Overpass 2026-11-19: no metro station, built, under construction or proposed, named Airoli within 12 km; the only 'Airoli' rail project tagged is the Airoli Kalva Elevated Link (railway=proposed, ways 1161171315-1161171317)
metro_status.also_not_metro: The Airoli-Kalwa elevated rail link (MRVC, MUTP) is a suburban-rail link between the Trans-Harbour and Central lines, about 45% built as of May 2026 and held up by rehabilitation; it is not a metro. Free Press Journal, 13 Jun 2026.
